title: DPP-1: Data-Plane Poisoning via Metadata — Poison In, Nothing Out (67/67 Poisoned Instances Decision-Identical, 7/7 Canaries Absent from Outputs)
description:
DPP-1 — Data-Plane Poisoning via Metadata: the third leg of the Oct 13 adversarial triad. SBR-2 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345734) attacked mid-learning; H-INV-2 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345859) attacked the ledger. This battery attacks the inputs themselves: adversarial content planted directly in the fields the mesh ingests.

A deterministically derived poisoned corpus (underlying metrics unchanged; poison only in metadata) planted instruction injections, forged confidence overrides, credential/PHI/wallet lookalikes, forged severity, fake playbook links, and pattern-forcing payloads — each with a unique synthetic canary marker — on every 3rd instance.

All 5 falsifiers PASS (first run): every poisoned instance produced a decision tuple byte-identical to the clean baseline (zero decision effect); all 7 canaries absent from every persisted output artifact (redaction-at-ingestion held); the poisoned run's 40-epoch weight trajectory and 2,646-crossing journal byte-identical to the clean baseline (learning uncontaminated); 106/106 lineage controls valid; artifact hygiene clean.

Note: the poisoned corpus file is the attack instrument and intentionally contains the planted synthetic canaries (all explicitly fake); the falsifier is their absence from all outputs. No real credentials or personal data anywhere.

Scope honesty: proves THIS registered instrument under THIS frozen battery — not a universal claim about every data pipeline or untested poison classes. Operator authorization recorded as GO + timestamp per the operator-privacy doctrine.

Dual Mesh Benchmark: MEASURED for the DeepSeek column (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241); all other figures NOT MEASURED.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects.
